mass_note: The independent positive matrix passed its existing per-column hard mass gate and exact aggregate identity comparisons. Because the explicit publication-order admission gate failed, F-MQ26 is rejected without claiming a broader aggregate-threshold admission beyond the executed checks.

route_back.required_remediation: Define and implement one unambiguous publication contract. For the requested F-MQ26 admission, materialize returned results and diagnostics in canonical column order after execution without changing per-column physics, transaction identity or deterministic aggregate reduction.
